```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

## Overview
This report provides transparency into the ENT pipeline data integrity and provenance. It captures checksums, file sizes, and timestamps for all intermediate and final artifacts generated by the ENT stakeholder visualization pipeline.

## File Provenance & Checksums

```{r provenance}
prov_path <- here::here("reports", "ent_provenance.csv")

if (file.exists(prov_path)) {
  prov <- read_csv(prov_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  summary_tbl <- prov %>%
    mutate(filename = basename(file)) %>%
    select(filename, checksum, size_bytes, recorded_at) %>%
    arrange(desc(recorded_at))
  
  knitr::kable(summary_tbl, 
               col.names = c("File", "SHA-256 Checksum", "Size (Bytes)", "Recorded At"),
               caption = "Provenance log of generated artifacts")
} else {
  cat("No provenance data found. Please run the pipeline to generate this report.")
}
```

## Pipeline Execution Logs

```{r logs}
log_path <- here::here("logs", "ent_pipeline.log")

if (file.exists(log_path)) {
  logs <- readLines(log_path)
  # Show last 50 lines
  recent_logs <- tail(logs, 50)
  cat("### Recent execution log entries:\n")
  cat("```\n")
  cat(paste(recent_logs, collapse = "\n"))
  cat("\n```")
} else {
  cat("No log file found.")
}
```

---
*Report generated automatically by the ENT hardened pipeline.*
